function.name: retrieve_textbook
function.description: Semantic search over the OS textbook vector store. Embeds the query into the same 384-dim space as stored chunks, computes cosine similarity, returns the top-k passages.

query.description: The search query to find relevant passages in the textbook.

k.description: Number of top passages to retrieve. Default is 3.

function.name: define_term
function.description: Returns a plain-English definition for common OS terms. Returns None if not found — caller falls back to retrieval.

function.name: search_wikipedia
function.description: Fetch a short summary from Wikipedia. Used when the question goes beyond the uploaded textbook content.

query.description: The query to search on Wikipedia.

function.name: generate_quiz
function.description: Retrieve content on a topic and structure a prompt asking the LLM to generate quiz questions from it.

topic.description: The topic to generate quiz questions about.

function.name: compare_concepts
function.description: Retrieve textbook content on two concepts separately, then combine. Used for 'difference between X and Y' questions.
